# 1. Process Description

Continuous transesterification of Triglycerides ($\text{TG}$) with Methanol ($\text{MeOH}$) using $\text{NaOH}$ catalyst to yield Fatty Acid Methyl Esters ($\text{FAME}$) and Glycerol ($\text{GL}$).

$$\text{Triglyceride (TG)} + 3\,\text{MeOH} \xrightarrow{\text{Catalyst}} 3\,\text{Biodiesel (FAME)} + \text{Glycerol (GL)}$$

# 2. Reaction Kinetics & Energy Model

## 2.1 Arrhenius Rate Law
$$r_A = k_0 \cdot \exp\left(-\frac{E_a}{R T}\right) \cdot C_{TG} \cdot C_{MeOH}^3$$

```{python}
#| label: reaction-kinetics-plot
#| fig-cap: "Arrhenius Reaction Rate Constant k(T) vs Temperature"
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Arrhenius parameters
k0 = 1.2e8
Ea = 45000.0  # J/mol
R = 8.314     # J/(mol*K)

T_degC = np.linspace(20, 80, 200)
T_K = T_degC + 273.15
k = k0 * np.exp(-Ea / (R * T_K))

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(T_degC, k, color='#4caf50', linewidth=2, label='Rate Constant k(T)')
plt.axvline(60.0, color='#ffd600', linestyle='--', label='Operating Temp (60°C)')
plt.title('Transesterification Reaction Rate Sensitivity', color='white')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (°C)', color='white')
plt.ylabel('Rate Constant k (L^3/mol^3 s)', color='white')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 2.2 Mass & Thermal Balances
$$V \frac{dC_{TG}}{dt} = F_{in} C_{TG,in} - F_{out} C_{TG} - V \cdot r_A$$

$$\rho C_p V \frac{dT}{dt} = \rho C_p F_{in}(T_{in} - T) + (-\Delta H_{rxn}) \cdot V \cdot r_A + U A_{jacket} (T_{jacket} - T) \cdot V_{cool}$$
